Rout is short by about 7.6×. The bottom devices sit at the edge of saturation, so their intrinsic gain (gm/gds) is only about 14. Compliance has about 0.1 V of slack (0.16 V measured against 0.26 V allowed), so I'll spend that slack on bottom-device Vds. Sensitivities point the same way: vds_b gives +38% rout and gmid_b gives +30% per +10% step. A longer cascode L should add another ~2× from intrinsic gain. The topology is right, so this is a refine step.
